jobs.tierReason: review of merge-queue and merge policy code: the guard that must stop a merge with a red or pending check
jobs.prompt: Review tools/merge-guard.mjs and coordination/review/merge-guard.diff against docs/plans/merge-guard-design.md. The one rule: a pull request is never merged while any check is failing or pending, and there is no way to skip it. Look for ways it can be bypassed or can fail open: check items with unexpected shapes or missing fields (null conclusion, unknown status or state values, lower-case values, a check run with status COMPLETED but no conclusion), grouping by name so that a newer green run hides a failing check with another name or a failing matrix entry, the newest-item rule being fooled by timestamps or missing timestamps (a stale success outranking a newer failure), an empty rollup or a rollup that has not been created yet right after a push, the head commit changing between the check and the merge (the match-head-commit flag), required versus optional, stacked PR handling and branch deletion, flags and argument parsing (an option smuggled in the PR argument, a URL for another repo, a repo value with odd characters), command injection through exec arguments, the local update step (it must not discard local work or run when the tree is dirty), the exit code and output for every refusal, and the ship change (the guard sits before the merge call on every path: held PRs, merge false, flaky reruns, resumed pipelines; lastFullRollup may be stale or empty when ship takes a path that never polled). Find real bugs with file and line evidence, rank high, medium, low, and say how to fix each. Do not edit files.
